identity_pass_1.finding: Identity confirmed. The 'DOI pending, 2016' citation appears only in the NIHMS author-manuscript supplement. The published article's reference 21 cites 'Gierahn, T. et al. Seq-Well protocol. Protocol Exchange http://dx.doi.org/10.1038/protex.2017.006a (2017)', and the publisher's Erratum (corrected after print 21 June 2017) states that the doi, link and date of 'the Seq-Well protocol in the Protocol Exchange' were corrected from protex.2017.006 to protex.2017.006a and from 2016 to 2017. Crossref protex.2017.006a: same nine authors as the manuscript citation (Gierahn, Wadsworth II, Hughes, Bryson, Butler, Satija, Fortune, Love, Shalek), issued 2017-03-14, resource URL = the protocols.io v1 record on disk. Printed content agrees with the Online Methods' use of it: the protocols.io import contains the chitosan functionalization followed by poly(glutamic) acid treatment that the Online Methods cite as 'step 8' and 'step 10' (the import renumbers them as steps 153 and 155 in one flat list). The basis is the publisher erratum plus authors, title, date and content, not authors and year alone.
